name: Steady Hands
description: You do not shake when it matters. Binding a wound under pressure comes as easily as at rest.

name: Practised Liar
description: The lie arrives already worn in. You have told this one before, in other towns, under other names.

name: Hard to Read
description: Your face gives nothing. Those reading you get less than they think they do.

name: Quiet Footed
description: Floorboards forgive you. You have left rooms nobody knew you entered.

name: Night Eyes
description: You see in the dark better than you should, and have stopped mentioning it.

name: Strong Back
description: You carry what two others would split, and are asked to, constantly.

name: Duellist
description: Trained for the single opponent who has agreed to it — a narrower education than it sounds, and a deadly one.

name: Field Surgeon
description: You have worked on people who were still being shot at. Speed, and a tolerance for screaming.

name: Grave-Touched
description: The dead find you legible. They answer a little more readily, and are no more honest for it.

name: The Old Tongue
description: You were taught the imperial speech by someone who remembered it being spoken in anger.
